## Checklist

- [ ] Branched off main, not pushed directly
- [ ] commits are small and their messages explain why
- [ ] names (files, classes etc) are consistent and descriptive
- [ ] functions are small and each does one thing
- [ ] no secrets are committed
- [ ] no large blocks of commented out code is left behind
- [ ] tests added or updated where it makes sense
- [ ] assignee and at least one reviewer set for this PR
